name: WACQT Quantum Hackathon 2026
organizer: WACQT (Wallenberg Centre for Quantum Technology) and IBM
description: The WACQT Quantum Hackathon at Chalmers University brought together approximately 40 participants to explore quantum technologies, collaborate in teams, and solve real-world problems using IBM's Qiskit quantum tools. Hosted by the Wallenberg Centre for Quantum Technology in Gothenburg, Sweden, the event included a mandatory preparation lecture on quantum computing with Qiskit before the two-day hackathon.
eligibility: Open to students and researchers, Qiskit preparation required

sources.title: Quantum Hackathon: Building Skills for the Future - Chalmers
